before_times: the kind of session (at the studio, at home, or by video or phone)
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
at home: what kind of place (a home or an office) and the town, before any times
after_time: what the client would like to focus on, in their own words (calm, sleep, pain, a change)
at home: parking, stairs, pets, and a quiet space with room for a chair or a table
secure_page_only: 18 or older, or 16 or 17 with a parent or guardian's consent on the page
the wellness form: current health concerns, a heart condition, epilepsy, pregnancy, recent surgery, medicines, skin conditions, and any doctor's care
for a teen: the parent's consent, and that the parent stays on site
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who stays on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, sudden weakness or numbness, or a seizure
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A session can wait.

stop.words: a new lump, bleeding that won't stop, or a symptom a doctor hasn't checked
stop.say: Please see a doctor first. Reiki doesn't replace medical care.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

go_on.words: a sore muscle or a small bruise
go_on.what: the practitioner works around it; the session goes on
the visit moves with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Wellness form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first session (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms or updates it by the day before (the studio: 6pm; the mobile business: 10am)
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the client's health changes
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (a heart condition, epilepsy, a recent surgery) goes to the practitioner to read before it books

steps.name: Practitioner's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the practitioner's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a lighter touch, an area skipped); a doctor's OK first; or no, with the reason kept private

steps.name: A teen's consent
steps.when: on the secure page, from the parent or guardian who books
steps.result: the parent shows an ID at check-in and stays on site

first_steps_and_forms.prep: come 5 minutes early; wear loose clothes; drink water; tell the studio on the secure page about any health change; at home: a quiet room with space for a chair or table, pets in another room

staff.skills: reiki levels I and II, hands-on and distance sessions, crystal add-ons; only practitioners with the level a booking names are offered
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no state license for reiki in most places; a certificate or training is each practitioner's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
staff.supervision: a student works only with a named practitioner in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs same-day sessions and new clients at the studio; he can set every home visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked practitioner, then to Sam after 1 hour
staff.stand_in: a stand-in must fit what the client asked (a woman, if asked) and the level booked, and gets the wellness form and notes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who stays on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's booking texts go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie never texts the teen
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent or guardian's written consent on the secure page for a 16 or 17 year old, and a parent on site

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at home: the code at the door, from the client who booked; by video or phone: the link on the secure page
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the practitioner; the practitioner's notes (what was focused on, what helped) go in the client's private record
visit.changes_at_visit: a crystal add-on or extra time is priced and OK'd before it's done
visit.before_work: the practitioner goes over the wellness form and what the client wants with the client before starting; the client keeps their clothes on and is covered by a blanket; the client can stop at any time

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: reiki has no state license in most places; a certificate or training is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
license.who: the business, for any registration it chooses to show; each practitioner's certificate is their own word
license.ask: optional: a registration number or a certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each practitioner
license.insurance: liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: health answers, pregnancy, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
